decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The roof tiles to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the pitched roof hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Site Location Plan, 6193 P 01 A Received: 29 August 2013 6193 P02 G Received: 18 October 2013) and the obscurely glazed panels shall be implemented, maintained, repaired or replaced to the heights and widths as indicated on drawing number 6193 P02 G received on 18 October 2013 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The obscure glazed panels located along the sides and front of the roof terrace shall be maintained, repaired or replaced with obscure glazed panels.
description: Formation of roof terrace to the rear of the property
